figurative_meaning_en: widespread cheers of victory or universal acclaim
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সাফল্যের জন্য সর্বত্র জয়জয়কার হচ্ছে।
নির্বাচনে জয় পাওয়ার পর তার জয়জয়কার শুরু হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Cheers of victory are echoing everywhere for his success.
After winning the election, cheers for him started all around.
note: This idiom is often used in contexts of public celebration and is deeply embedded in Bengali expressive language for triumph.
